data.narrative: A systemic breach of the core banking platform was detected, involving unauthorized administrative access to the account management API via compromised service account credentials (svc_acct_mgmt). The attacker performed bulk account enumeration and automated balance queries across all customer accounts, indicating preparation for mass wire fraud. Emergency containment required a platform-wide account freeze due to the depth of the compromise. Standard per-account freezing mechanisms were ineffective as the attacker could bypass them via the compromised admin channel. No funds were transferred prior to containment. This incident reflects a critical insider threat or credential compromise with systemic risk implications. All actions were logged and reported through the fraud detection pipeline.
